sources.type: publicly accessible single-cadaver full-body CT image stack
sources.access_note: NLM reports no registration required for its FTP data since 2019; consult NLM Terms and Conditions before redistributing derived material.
sources.allowed_role: independent adult male skeletal SURFACE shape reference for pelvis/sacrum/femur and spine, after segmentation and independent source checking
sources.disallowed_role: single cadaver cannot establish 1.82 m population target or automatically supersede canonical skeleton
must_verify: Actual CT metadata: image spacing, slice orientation and scanner/world transforms
Sex/stature/posture identity relevant to intended use; do not infer individual stature
Independent femoral head articular, pelvic ASIS/pubic and S1 endplate segmentation correctness
Source geometry sample/source SHA-256 and reproducible physical landmark extraction
Sex/stature compatible independent population anatomy for proportion target
Original NLM access conditions and any downstream IDC/DICOM conversion terms
Noncanonical, source-registered Blender visual and numerical review

reference_set_role: supporting geometry, not canonical anthropometric or movement targets
